title: 第1798章 白若水害我第1797章 精疲力尽
lines: 时间转眼便来到了二月二十四日，距离灵山大比还有六天的时间。
自从叶风入定醒来之后，连续好几日，白天修炼气运之术，晚上修炼神魂之力。
连日的努力，还是有所回报的。
神魂之力强大了一些倒是其次。
关键是在气运修炼上有了很大的进展。
这一日，叶风如往常一样，调动传国玉玺内的气运之力进入身体，然后淬炼心灵穴上的星火。
这是白若水传授的气运修炼之法的第二重聚火。
经过多日修炼，再加上源源不断的气运之力涌入，终于在这一日，叶风发现自己心灵穴上的那点星火发生了变化。
从最初的橘黄色，竟然变成了七彩之色。
叶风发现这一变化后心中大喜，因为根据口诀所言，这是第三重凝芯的标志。
所谓凝芯，便是以众生气运凝聚火芯，这是达到第四重燃灯的先决条件。
叶风打算再过几日，自己若是还没有凝芯成功的话，就去万佛峰找白若水请教一下。
没想到自己就在这么不经意间突破了。
当凝芯成功了，不仅星火变成的七彩光泽，心灵穴上的那个漩涡，也开始发生改变。
以前叶风是无法控制这个漩涡的转速的，此刻他似乎与这个漩涡产生了一些微妙的联系。
叶风小心翼翼的控制神念渗入漩涡之中。
在他心念的控制下，漩涡的转速开始改变，随着叶风的意念加快或者放慢，但无法让漩涡完全停止。
而那道七彩灯芯，似乎与七彩漩涡也有一定的联系。
当叶风加速转动漩涡时，七彩灯芯明显开始发亮。当转速过慢时，则又开始慢慢变暗。
同时叶风还敏锐的捕捉到，丝丝缕缕的气运之力，通过漩涡从心灵穴中释放出来，滋补着七彩灯芯。
当漩涡转速加快时，气运之力便开始加速从心灵穴中释放出来。
叶风瞬间就明白了过来。
“原来如此……”
他总算是搞明白了气运修炼之法的心灯的形成原因了。
其实修炼气运与修炼丹田元神的原理差不多。
不同的是，两种力量存储的地方不一样。
人体内有三海，修士一般只开发出了两海，那便是丹田之海与神魂之海。
至于心灵之海，对修士来说却是极为神秘的。
目前人间能开发心灵之海的，只有儒家修士，以及佛门修士。
不过佛门以前是修心的，修炼的也是气运之术。
但是佛门的气运修炼之法，和儒家的修炼体系，都有一个巨大的弊端，那就是不完整，所以难以长寿。
于是佛门也就慢慢的改变了修炼方式，开始主修元神与丹田。
虽然改了，但佛门的很多东西却保留下来。
比如在凡尘世俗中兴建庙宇道场。
以前佛门之所以在凡人聚集的地方修建庙宇道场，且不禁止凡人前来烧香礼佛，其主要目的就是搜集这些凡人的香火之力。
后来佛门改了修炼之法后，不需要收集凡人香火了，但他们发现可以搂钱，所以这个传统也就保存了下来。
人间除了佛门与儒家之外，其他流派的修士是很难开启心灵之海的。
content_en:
Time came to February 24th in a blink of an eye, and there were still six days left before the Lingshan Competition.
After Ye Feng woke up from trance, he practiced the art of luck during the day and the power of the soul at night for several days in a row.
Days of hard work have paid off.
The power of the soul is a little stronger, but that's the second best.
The key is that great progress has been made in Qi Luck cultivation.
On this day, as usual, Ye Feng mobilized the power of luck in the Jade Seal of the Kingdom to enter his body, and then tempered the sparks on his spiritual acupoints.
This is the second stage of gathering fire in the Qi Luck cultivation method taught by Bai Ruoshui.
After many days of practice, coupled with the continuous influx of luck, finally on this day, Ye Feng discovered that the spark in his spiritual point had changed.
From the original orange color, it turned into colorful colors.
Ye Feng was overjoyed when he discovered this change, because according to the formula, this was a sign of the third level of core concentration.
The so-called core condensation is to condense the core of fire with the fate of all living beings. This is a prerequisite for reaching the fourth relighting lamp.
Ye Feng planned to go to Ten Thousand Buddhas Peak to ask Bai Ruoshui for advice if he had not succeeded in condensing the core in a few days.
I didn't expect that I would break through so inadvertently.
When the core condensation is successful, not only the sparkle turns into a colorful luster, but also the vortex on the spiritual point begins to change.
In the past, Ye Feng could not control the speed of this vortex, but now he seemed to have some subtle connection with the vortex.
Ye Feng carefully controlled his spiritual thoughts to penetrate into the vortex.
Under the control of his mind, the speed of the vortex began to change, speeding up or slowing down with Ye Feng's thoughts, but he could not stop the vortex completely.
And that colorful wick seems to have a certain connection with the colorful whirlpool.
As the leaf wind accelerates and turns the vortex, the colorful wicks obviously begin to glow. When the rotation speed is too slow, it starts to slowly dim again.
At the same time, Ye Feng was also keenly aware that the power of luck was released from the soul acupoint through the vortex, nourishing the colorful wick.
When the speed of the vortex speeds up, the power of luck begins to be released from the spiritual point at an accelerated rate.
Ye Feng understood instantly.
"That's it..."
He finally figured out the reason for the formation of the heart lamp of the Qi Luck Cultivation Method.
In fact, the principles of cultivating Qi Luck are similar to cultivating Dantian Yuanshen.
The difference is that the two powers are stored in different places.
There are three seas in the human body, and monks generally only develop two seas, namely the sea of ​​dantian and the sea of ​​soul.
As for the sea of ​​soul, it is extremely mysterious to monks.
Currently, the only people in the world who can develop the sea of ​​soul are Confucian monks and Buddhist monks.
However, Buddhism used to cultivate the mind and also practiced the art of luck.
However, both the Buddhist Qi Luck cultivation method and the Confucian cultivation system have a huge drawback, that is, they are incomplete, so it is difficult to live long.
As a result, Buddhism slowly changed its cultivation methods and began to focus on Yuanshen and Dantian.
Although it has changed, many things about Buddhism have been retained.
For example, building temples and dojos in the secular world.
In the past, the main reason why Buddhism built temples and monasteries in places where mortals gathered, and did not prohibit mortals from coming to burn incense and worship Buddha, was to collect the power of incense from these mortals.
Later, after Buddhism changed the method of cultivation, there was no need to collect incense from mortals, but they found that they could make money, so this tradition was preserved.
Except for Buddhism and Confucianism, it is difficult for monks from other schools to open the sea of ​​soul.
